spec.title: Setup: build ICU4J core at both #3249 revisions and run the RBBI word-break tests
spec.description: Setup for extension case D of llm-dlc/loops/organic-java-pr-capability-composition-fast-follow.md, no claims. In the setup worktrees under ~/.cache/in-the-loop/organic-composition-ff/worktrees (D-icu-fix = 8d86ca14, D-icu-parent = d868f13b), builds icu4j main/core (with -am: framework) with Maven 3.10.0 on JDK 17.0.21 into the cache's own m2 (first step online, the rest offline). Runs RBBITestExtended,RBBIMonkeyTest,RBBITestMonkey,RBBITest,RBBIAPITest,BreakIteratorTest on each side, then the landed test files (RBBITestMonkey.java, break_rules/word.txt, word_POSIX.txt, rbbitst.txt) transplanted onto the parent, where they are expected to fail, then the landed tests offline on the fix. Core jars to .../artifacts with sha256, JUnit summaries to .../logs, build trees removed. Results go into llm-dlc/loops/organic-java-pr-capability-composition-fast-follow-setup.md.
spec.expected: every step exits 0: the RBBI tests pass on both sides' own trees; the transplanted landed files fail on the parent; the offline rerun passes
